report_notes: Full October 5 rerun of all ten runtimes with PostgreSQL max_connections=2000. PHP 8.5.11, FrankenPHP 1.13.0, FreeUnit 1.37.0, and opcache.enable_file_override=1.
Unrelated development containers were running on the host during the measurements.
All 20 scenarios completed all 13 load stages. All six Rapira scenarios recorded socket-read errors; the other 14 scenarios recorded zero errors.
OxPHP worker database completed with zero errors after raising PostgreSQL max_connections from 200 to 2000. Its sampled peak was 441 client connections, including the monitoring connection.

PostgreSQL connections were sampled every 30 seconds from FreeUnit onward, with a gap during an agent restart. Sampling is not a continuous peak measurement. Rapira worker application logs were empty when inspected after socket-read errors.
